emma (eng-platform): Heads-up: we've got a small but noisy mismatch between Routing Inspector traces and decision-logs for requests that have mixed-case x-app-route headers. Seen it in canary for 2026-11-03 deploy.
raj (eng-runtime): can you paste a trace id / example request?
emma (eng-platform): sure — sample trace id: trace-20261103-9a7c
emma (eng-platform): decision-log excerpt:
```
req_id=8f3a route=default handler=compose-v2 matched_rule_id=rule-123 headers={"x-app-route":"ReWrite-v1","X-Request-Id":"8f3a"}
```
emma (eng-platform): routing-inspector shows match to rewrite-v2 for the same req id.
sofia (eng-sre): hmm header canonicalization bug? we canonicalize headers in the gateway but decision-logs are logging raw headers from the pre-canonicalized envelope.
raj (eng-runtime): that's possible. The kernel that evaluates route-headers uses lowercased keys, but the decision-logger reads from the inbound map before canonicalization.
emma (eng-platform): repro steps I used: curl -H 'x-app-route: ReWrite-v1' -H 'X-App-Route: rewrite-v2' to the /generate endpoint. Occasionally the rule for rewrite-v2 wins in the runtime but the decision-log shows rewrite-v1.
sofia (eng-sre): could be sampling mismatch too — if the inspector is showing a full trace (always-sample) and decision-logs are sampled differently we could see stale cached decisions.
raj (eng-runtime): quick check: can we enable full decision logging for that instance and correlate the KV-cache evictions? I can flip a flag if infra-bot helps. @infra-bot can you toggle decision-logging=sampled:0 for node group canary-11?
infra-bot: request received. Toggling decision-logging sampling to 0 for fleet canary-11... done. (changed by raj) :white_check_mark:
dl-decision-logger-bot: ingest-rate=full, target=canary-11, sampling=0. Note: retention=24h for full dumps.
emma (eng-platform): thanks. Also adding a small log patch to include canonicalized headers in the decision payload so we have both pre/post keys for debugging. sending PR now.
raj (eng-runtime): paste the PR link?
emma (eng-platform): https://git.internal/redwood/routing/PR/4523
sofia (eng-sre): while that's rolling, can we add a temporary dashboard tile in Console: route-eval-mismatch-rate by node? I want to see if it's concentrated on a single zone.
emma (eng-platform): yep — I'll add a quick freespan metric: routing.evaluator.mismatch_ratio (per-node) and wire it to alerts > 0.5% per 10m.
raj (eng-runtime): dev note: if this is header canonicalization, fix should be to move canonicalization earlier in path so both runtime and logger read the same map. I'll prepare a small change to do that and gate with flag.
sofia (eng-sre): plan summary: 1) decision-logging sampling off for canary-11 (done) 2) PR to include canonicalized header snapshot in decision-logs (emma) 3) runtime flag to canonicalize earlier (raj) 4) temp dashboard tile + alert (emma) 5) monitor for 1h then rollback if error spike.
emma (eng-platform): assigned follow-ups in backlog. tagging @raj and @sofia for postmortem if needed.
raj (eng-runtime): one more check — tokenization of header values (we strip whitespace). Could be 'ReWrite-v1' vs 'rewrite-v1' case-sensitivity in rule matchers. I'll add a unit to cover mixed-case and dup header keys.
sofia (eng-sre): thanks all. keep updates here. if mismatch rate doesn't drop after patch + canonicalize, we may need to dig into policy-eval ordering.
emma (eng-platform): noted. I'll post a short note in eng-platform channel when the dashboard is up and when we have 1h of data. :mag_right:
infra-bot: rolling restart for canary-11 nodes queued (reason: enable full decision logs)
infra-bot: restart completed on 3/3 nodes.
dl-decision-logger-bot: incoming full decision dump for trace-20261103-9a7c attached to request 8f3a.
emma (eng-platform): got the full dump — confirms canonicalization mismatch: decision-log shows raw keys, but the runtime matched on lowercased key set. PR merged, starting rollout.
sofia (eng-sre): mismatch rate down to 0.02% after 20m. closing the urgent loop but will keep monitor for 6h. :tada:
